description: This file defines the Git::SVN::Ra package, a Perl module that wraps SVN::Ra for use with git-svn. It adds caching, compatibility handling for different SVN versions, and custom functions for git-svn integration.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Ra
classes.description: A Perl module that wraps SVN::Ra for git-svn, providing caching, compatibility, and additional functions.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Creates a new SVN::Ra object with canonicalized URL and caching.

methods.name: check_path
methods.description: Checks if a path exists in the repository with caching.

methods.name: get_dir
methods.description: Retrieves directory entries with caching and SVN version compatibility.

methods.name: get_log
methods.description: Retrieves commit logs with adjustments for SVN version limitations.

methods.name: trees_match
methods.description: Compares two repository trees for differences (for SVN <= 1.4.2).

methods.name: get_commit_editor
methods.description: Gets a commit editor, with SVN version compatibility.

methods.name: gs_do_update
methods.description: Performs an update operation on a git-svn working copy.

methods.name: gs_do_switch
methods.description: Switches the working copy to a different URL, handling reparenting if needed.

methods.name: longest_common_path
methods.description: Finds the longest common path among a set of git-svn objects and globs.

methods.name: gs_fetch_loop_common
methods.description: Fetches logs and commits in a loop, handling revisions and deletions.

methods.name: get_dir_globbed
methods.description: Recursively retrieves directory entries up to a specified depth.

methods.name: minimize_url
methods.description: Reduces the URL to its minimal form relative to the repository root.

methods.name: can_do_switch
methods.description: Checks if the SVN server supports switching.

methods.name: skip_unknown_revs
methods.description: Handles specific SVN errors by ignoring certain error codes.

methods.name: is_ref_ignored
methods.description: Determines if a reference path should be ignored based on regex patterns.

methods.name: match_globs
methods.description: Matches directory globs against repository paths and populates the exists map.
